title: Add node hover tooltip with SIPOC data preview
description: React Flow UI now has an official NodeTooltip component (reactflow.dev/ui/components/node-tooltip) — a wrapper that displays rich content when hovering over a node. Use this to show a quick SIPOC preview tooltip on hover without requiring the user to open the side panel. The tooltip could show: process description (first 100 chars), supplier count, input count, output count, customer count, and metrics (CT/LT/VA%) if present. This reduces the friction of needing to double-click each node to see its data during presentations or reviews. Quick glance → full detail is a common UX pattern. Consider whether to use the official NodeTooltip from @xyflow/react UI or build a lightweight version using the existing NodeToolbar component with isVisible controlled by hover state.
